title: crosshair plus
description: Crosshair+ - The Ultimate Pixel-Based PvP Editor
body:
## Crosshair+ — The Ultimate Pixel-Based PvP Editor

Crosshair+ is a powerful, creative tool designed for competitive players who demand both aesthetics and functionality. Built on the modern owo-lib framework, it offers a sleek, premium settings menu and unparalleled pixel-by-pixel customization to help you dominate the arena.

## Key Features
Dual-Grid Editor: Design your crosshair using classic parameter sliders (size, thickness, gap) or draw pixel-by-pixel with a precision 15x15 canvas editor.

## Dynamic Battle Modes:
Automatically switch your crosshair designs between Normal and Battle (combat/aiming) modes to maximize focus during PvP fights.

## Intuitive Tools:
Utilize dedicated pencil and eraser tools with simple mouse toggles for precise pixel placement.

## Premium Theme Design:
Experience a unified, beautiful palette with custom-colored sliders and clean, modern interface elements.

## Bilingual Support:
Persistent in-game language switcher (English / Русский) with full translation across all tabs and labels.

## Instant Access:
Open the graphical editor instantly in-game by pressing a configurable hotkey (Default: G).

## How to Use
Download and install Fabric API and owo-lib.

Place the Crosshair+ jar file into your mods folder.

Launch the game and press G to open the editor.

Customize your crosshair, set your combat preferences, and hit the arena!
